title: "Icon & Username"
format: html
extensions:
  support-this:

    platforms:
      github: coatless

      buy_me_a_coffee: username
filters: [support-this]
---

With `display: icon-username`, each link shows the platform's icon and the account, without the platform's name. It is more compact than the default and works well when readers know the platforms by their logos.

## Configuration

```yaml
extensions:
  support-this:
    display: icon-username
    description: "Your support keeps this work going."
    platforms:
      github: coatless
      patreon: username
      ko_fi: username
      buy_me_a_coffee: username
filters: [support-this]
```

## Other formats

Typst and Word show the same icons. In RevealJS, the icon is a symbol for the platform. PDF output leaves the icons out, since LaTeX's default fonts can't display them, and shows the platform's name in their place.

The other display modes are [Icon, Platform & Username](qsupport-this-display-icon-platform-username.qmd), [Text](qsupport-this-display-text.qmd), and [Badges](qsupport-this-display-badge.qmd).
